clue.text: But is it less important than a diplomatic bag?

definitions.text: But is it less important than a diplomatic bag?

parts.words: But is it less important than a diplomatic bag?
parts.note: an attaché is a junior member of an embassy's staff, so the playful reading imagines a lesser envoy's case ranking below the official diplomatic bag

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about the pecking order of luggage carried by diplomats.
explanation.definitionFit: A slim hard briefcase for papers takes its name from embassy attachés, junior diplomatic staff.

clue.text: Excessively long implement

parts.note: excessively means too, as in too much

explanation.surface: Describing an implement with an overlong handle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool is any hand implement used for a job, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Mean to declare how old one is

parts.note: to aver is to declare or assert
your age is how old you are

explanation.surface: Someone meaning to announce their age.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' reads as a verb (intend) in the surface but is the noun or adjective sense, the arithmetic middle value.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean of a set of numbers is its arithmetical middle value, a synonym.

clue.text: Henry has stirred there heated dish

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for henry, the unit of electrical inductance

indicators.note: stirred suggests mixing up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A man called Henry stirs a pot of something warm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stirred' is the anagram signal, mixing the word has; 'there' is only a link between the wordplay and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A hash is a cooked dish of chopped meat and potatoes, served hot.

clue.text: Yellow, smart range

parts.note: chic means smart or stylish
ken is range of knowledge, as in beyond one's ken

explanation.surface: A fashion note on a stylish range of yellow clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yellow' looks like a colour but means cowardly; 'ken' is the old word for the range of what one knows.
explanation.definitionFit: Yellow is slang for cowardly, and a coward is called a scaredy-cat or worse.

clue.text: Slough, a place for potters?

definitions.meaning: to slough is to cast off, as a snake does its skin
a garden hut where someone potters about, not a pottery

explanation.surface: Asking whether an English town is a place for pottery makers.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough is also an English town near London, and 'potters' suggests ceramic makers rather than people who potter about.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast off skin is the verb sense; a garden outbuilding is where a pottering gardener spends time.

clue.text: Maker of pancakes that end on the face

definitions.text: Maker of pancakes that end on the face

parts.words: Maker of pancakes that end on the face
parts.note: pancake is also a heavy stage make-up, so the maker is a beauty professional, not a cook whose batter lands on someone

explanation.surface: A cook whose pancakes end up in someone's face.
explanation.definitionFit: A make-up specialist applies pancake foundation to customers' faces.

clue.text: Lucky thing there is a brass spinner!

parts.note: brass is slang for cash
a spider spins its web

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a lucky charm made of brass that spins.
explanation.walkthrough: Folk belief holds that a tiny spider running over you brings wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: A small spider of folklore is believed to bring good fortune to whoever it lands on.

clue.text: Sort of thrush that can take off expertly?

definitions.text: Sort of thrush that can take off expertly?

parts.words: Sort of thrush that can take off expertly?
parts.note: take off means mimic, so this is a thrush-like bird skilled at imitating others, not one good at flying away

explanation.surface: A songbird praised for its fine take-offs.
explanation.definitionFit: This American songbird of the thrush family is famous for imitating other birds' calls.

clue.text: Wireless operative slowly disintergrating?

parts.note: wireless is the old word for a radio set
active means operative or working

explanation.surface: An old radio operator gradually falling apart.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'disintergrating' is a typo for disintegrating; the definition describes atoms decaying.
explanation.definitionFit: Unstable atoms emit particles as they gradually break down, which is the property described.

clue.text: Lumberjacks' overseers at it, quarrelling?

parts.note: chiefs of tree-fellers would be heads of loggers, and the idiom for people in dispute is at such-and-such

explanation.surface: Bosses of a logging crew having a row.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'at ...' describes people in fierce dispute; split, the word reads as chiefs of wood-cutters.

clue.text: Money in Greece made old boy look back

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: back tells us the word for look is written in the opposite direction

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: A former schoolboy in Greece looks over his shoulder at money.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient Greek coin of small value, worth a sixth of a drachma.

clue.text: Pop needs oxygen after wall-decoration…

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: Father needs some air after decorating the walls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs' and 'after' only join the pieces; the ellipsis leads into the next clue's surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The lower part of an interior wall, often panelled or painted differently, is a decorative feature.

clue.text: … and Mum takes sovereigns for materials

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
kings are sovereigns, rulers

explanation.surface: Continuing the family scene: mother pockets gold coins.
explanation.walkthrough: Sovereigns suggests gold coins, but here means monarchs.
explanation.definitionFit: The ingredients or raw stuff needed to make something, as in 'the ... of a champion'.

clue.text: Pitch poles broken

indicators.note: broken suggests the poles are smashed, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sports ground whose posts have been smashed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitch' suggests a sports field but means an incline.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitch is the angle or incline of something, such as a roof, a synonym.

clue.text: Court investigation makes sense

definitions.meaning: a trial or session in which a case is examined by a judge
one of the five senses, perceiving sound

explanation.surface: A court inquiry that seems sensible.
explanation.definitionFit: A judicial session examining evidence; also the faculty of perceiving sounds.

clue.text: Nettlerash colonies

definitions.meaning: nettlerash is urticaria, an itchy skin rash
bee colonies live in man-made boxes

explanation.surface: A skin rash spreading in patches.
explanation.definitionFit: Urticaria is commonly called by this plural name; bee colonies inhabit such structures.

clue.text: Playful German XI at home

parts.note: elf is the German word for eleven, XI in Roman numerals
in means at home

explanation.surface: A German football team relaxing at home.
explanation.walkthrough: XI suggests a football team; it is the number eleven translated into German.
explanation.definitionFit: Mischievous and sprightly, like a fairy creature, a synonym of playful.

clue.text: Tiny creature goes backwards-smack!

indicators.note: goes backwards tells us to write the insect's name in reverse

parts.note: a gnat is a tiny insect

explanation.surface: A small insect reverses and gets swatted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smack' suggests a slap but means a taste or flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack of something is a slight taste or flavour, a synonym.

clue.text: Blonde female takes bearing

parts.note: an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: A fair-haired woman carries herself well.
explanation.definitionFit: Light-coloured hair is described as pale or golden, a synonym of blonde.

clue.text: Moral declines do not begin in such parts of churches

indicators.note: do not begin means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: lapses are moral failings or declines

explanation.surface: A sermon about moral decline in church.
explanation.definitionFit: Semicircular recesses at the east end of a church, behind the altar.

clue.text: Opposed to making a profit on street

parts.note: gain means profit

explanation.surface: Objecting to someone turning a profit on a street.
explanation.definitionFit: To be against something is to be opposed to it, a synonym.

clue.text: Colonist who stumps up

definitions.meaning: someone who makes a home in a new land
one who pays or settles a bill

explanation.surface: A colonist who pays his way.
explanation.walkthrough: To stump up is British slang for paying up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer establishes himself in a new land; one who settles an account pays it.

clue.text: Bunch of keys for an unimaginative fellow?

definitions.meaning: each letter of the word is a musical key or note name, A to G
a dull, inactive person, like a vegetable

explanation.surface: A keyring belonging to a dull man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keys' suggests a door keyring, but C, A, B, B, A, G and E are all musical keys.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters are all musical note names; also slang for a dull, vegetating person.

clue.text: Let's eat out in port

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A suggestion to dine out at a port.
explanation.definitionFit: A major Pacific port city in Washington State, an example of a port.

clue.text: Displays affectation

definitions.meaning: to put on show or broadcast, as views or programmes are aired
pretentious manners, as in putting on graces

explanation.surface: Showing off pretentiously.
explanation.definitionFit: To broadcast or show publicly; and pretentious mannerisms as in 'putting on graces'.

clue.text: On the turf, one can make a splash

parts.note: a sod is a piece of turf
A means one

explanation.surface: Someone on the lawn ready to make a splash.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'splash' of soda water is added to a drink; 'can' hints at the tin it comes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Fizzy water is added as a splash to whisky, and comes in cans.

clue.text: Sound of dismissal we hear in Oxford, for example

indicators.note: sound of tells us the word is said aloud rather than written
we hear confirms that a word is heard, not spelt

parts.note: shoo is the word said to drive someone away

explanation.surface: Hearing a dismissal spoken in the university city.
explanation.walkthrough: Oxford suggests the city; it is a lace-up style of footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oxford is a classic style of lace-up footwear, an example.

clue.text: This poet got nothing with sixpence

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
VI d is six pence in old British money, VI being Roman six and d the penny abbreviation

explanation.surface: A poet who earned nothing but sixpence.
explanation.walkthrough: Old British money wrote pence as d, so sixpence is VID.
explanation.definitionFit: Ovid was a Roman poet, author of the Metamorphoses.

clue.text: Load of extra pay not opened

indicators.note: not opened means the opening letter is taken away

parts.note: a bonus is extra pay

explanation.surface: A pay packet with a bonus left unopened.
explanation.definitionFit: A burden or responsibility, a load to carry.

clue.text: Relatively unimportant dancer to tackle the bar?

definitions.text: Relatively unimportant dancer to tackle the bar?

parts.words: Relatively unimportant dancer to tackle the bar?
parts.note: a dancer placed far along the chorus line is minor, and a dancer working at the barre is practising

explanation.surface: A lowly ballet dancer heading for the practice rail.
explanation.definitionFit: In a chorus line the lesser dancers stand further along, so the phrase means later or of lesser rank.

clue.text: Uniform made from scrap material?

parts.note: a scrap is a fight, a battle
dress can be material or fabric for clothing, as in dress fabric

explanation.surface: A uniform sewn from leftover pieces of cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrap material' reads as leftover cloth, but scrap is a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers' field uniform is the combat outfit worn in action.
